description: Header file defining the interface for a finite state machine (FSM) management in a wireless device context, including structures, macros, and function prototypes related to FSM actions, locking, and dependency checks.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm
methods.description: Performs FSM processing for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_reset
methods.description: Resets the FSM state for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_cleanFsmBits
methods.description: Cleans FSM bits for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_cleanAcFsmBits
methods.description: Cleans access point FSM bits for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_clearFsmBitForAll
methods.description: Clears a specific FSM bit for all radios.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_doesExternalLocking
methods.description: Checks if external locking is used for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_tryGetLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire lock on a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_ensureLock
methods.description: Ensures the current radio has a lock.

methods.name: wld_fsm_init
methods.description: Initializes FSM manager with vendor and FSM manager structures.

methods.name: wld_fsm_getNrNotIdle
methods.description: Returns the number of radios not in idle state.
